# List available CT versions

List available CT versions

## Usage

``` r
available_ct_versions(type = c("sdtm", "adam"))
```

## Arguments

- type:

  One of `"sdtm"` or `"adam"`.

## Value

Character vector of version date strings, newest first, e.g.
`c("2026-03-27", "2025-09-27", ...)`.
